_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Sabon zagaye - Dice masu rage: {dice_summary}
Dice na yanzu suna: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Ɗon ƙwara {current_player_id} ya kira! Jimillar adadin fuska {face_value} shine {count}, wanda >= {quantity}.
Ɗon ƙwara {loser_id} (mai kira) ya rasa die daya.

action.bid_announce: Ɗon ƙwara {player_id} yin bidda {quantity} na fuska {face_value}.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Call made with no prior bid.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Aikin ba a gane shi a matsayin ko '[Bid: X, Y]' ko '[Call]' na halal. Aikin da aka gabatar: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Sabon adadin {new_quantity} ƙasa ce fiye da na yanzu {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Sabon darasin fuska {new_face_value} ƙasa ce fiye da na yanzu {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Bid is identical to the current bid.
bid_reason.face_range: Nəm tamanne dә kate 1 kuru 6 lan kara.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} was eliminated by invalid move.

outcome.win: Ɗon ƙwara {winner} ya lashe! Zaɓen ƙarshe: {final_ranking}
